obvious_hallucination.reason: Static inspection reveals three concrete conflicts: (1) The code (run_experiments.py) implements no custom 'compressed framework' — it simply runs off-the-shelf allenai/led-base-16384 and facebook/bart-large-cnn without any KV compression, routing, or retrieval. (2) The actual timing data in results.json shows LED is 3.4× SLOWER than BART (2.03s vs 0.60s), contradicting the claim of 4× speedups. (3) The actual memory data shows LED uses 28% MORE memory than BART (2.28GB vs 1.78GB), contradicting the ≈70% memory reduction claim. Furthermore, the absolute ROUGE-1 drop is ~15% (0.313 vs 0.159), far exceeding the claimed 1–2%. The 'proposed' method is misrepresented as implementing a novel architecture that does not exist in the repository.
